answer: The sable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the signal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
